newsitem.title: UK: Bakyrchik in financing talks, shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Bakyrchik in financing talks, shrs suspended.

text.p: London-listed mining company Bakyrchik Gold Plc said on Tuesday it requested a temporary suspension in trading of its shares due to current financing talks.
The company said it was in talks that could result in additional short-term financing and lead to a restructuring of its ownership of the Bakyrchik gold mine in Kazakhstan.
Bakyrchik said it expected to announce further details shortly.
In February, the company raised about 7.1 million stg by placing some 3.8 million shares to help fund feasibility studies on the Bakyrchik gold mine.
The company's shares closed on Monday at 83.5p. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
